@patch('subprocess.run')
    def test_flatpak_get_packages(self, mock_run):
        """Test Flatpak package listing."""
        mock_run.return_value = MagicMock(
            stdout="Application ID\tName\tVersion\ncom.spotify.Client\tSpotify\t1.2.3\n",
            returncode=0
        )
        
        manager = FlatpakManager()
        packages = manager.get_installed_packages()
        
        self.assertEqual(len(packages), 1)
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["name"], "com.spotify.Client")
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["display_name"], "Spotify")
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["version"], "1.2.3")
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["manager"], "flatpak")
